disclaimer: Latest available measurements at other places and times. Not a forecast for the route.

rems.note: REMS values via the Centro de Astrobiologia (CAB) outreach feed; CAB points to the PDS for scientific REMS data. Wind and humidity are not reported in this feed.

insight.note: Last sols published by the InSight weather service, Elysium Planitia, 2020.

rad.what: Average galactic cosmic ray dose equivalent rate on the surface at Gale crater, measured by Curiosity's RAD. The rate varies from day to night with atmospheric shielding.
rad.distance_note: Measured by Curiosity in Gale crater, about the same region as the walk.
